questions.q: ArduPilot accepts DISTANCE_SENSOR as a downward rangefinder with:
questions.explain: 10 is MAVLink, 25 is Down; the orientation in the message must match.

questions.q: What should a component do when it loses measurements?
options: Keep sending the last value at the same rate
questions.explain: The autopilot will detect the timeout and disable the source.

questions.q: Quickly show your own number in the GCS and the log without your own dialect:
questions.explain: The GCS shows the value, ArduPilot writes it to the log as NVAL.

questions.q: MAVLink frames from an ESP32 are sometimes broken. The likely cause:
options: Several tasks write to the UART
A too-frequent heartbeat clogs the buffer
questions.explain: You need a single sender task or a mutex on the UART.

questions.q: Which test level proves that the autopilot uses the component's data?
options: SITL with a check in the log
A test against a fake vehicle
questions.explain: Only it verifies that the parameters and the message agree.
